EXAM TYPE: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
EXAM DATE AND TIME: [DATE] [TIME]
INDICATION: Degenerative joint disease
COMPARISON: None

Impression:  
1. Mild cartilage loss at the patellofemoral joint.
2. Small focus of marrow edema involving the anterior aspect of the tibial plateau which may represent a small marrow contusion.
3. Chronic fragmentation of the tibial tubercle which may reflect old Osgood-Schlatter disease.


Technique:  Magnetic Resonance Imaging of the left knee was performed utilizing sagittal T2 weighted and fat suppressed proton density, coronal T1 weighted and fat suppressed proton density, and axial fat suppressed T2 weighted sequences.


Comment:

Menisci: Intact

Cruciate ligaments: Intact

Collateral ligaments: Intact

Extensor mechanism: Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. There is fragmentation of the tibial tubercle which may reflect old Osgood-Schlatter disease.

Joint fluid/Baker's cyst: There is minimal joint fluid which is likely physiologic in nature. There is no significant Baker's cyst.

Bone marrow: There is a small focus of marrow edema involving the anterior aspect of the tibial plateau which may represent a small marrow contusion.

Femorotibial joints: No significant cartilage defects.

Patellofemoral joint: There is cartilage heterogeneity across the patellofemoral joint, with minimal subchondral marrow edema at the central trochlea.

Trouvailles :

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.

Il y a changements dégénératifs au niveau patellofémoral avec amincissement modéré du cartilage à la facette latérale de la rotule. Il y a un léger amincissement au niveau de la trochlée du fémur. Il y a aussi léger amincissement et fibrillation superficielle du cartilage du compartiment interne et externe. Il n’y a aucune région de perte de cartilage complet.

Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ménisque interne, le ménisque externe, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

1. Changements dégénératifs impliquant les trois compartiments du genou sans région de perte de cartilage complet tel que détaillé ci-haut.

2. Petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.

3. Aucune déchirure méniscale.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Dolor medial. Obs. Síndrome meniscal.
Hallazgos:
Discreto edema óseo periférico del cóndilo femoral medial con imagen sugerente de pequeña
fractura subcortical regional. No hay otras alteraciones de señal de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Ambos meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor prácticamente total la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo
femoral medial. Condropatía superficial del platillo tibial medial. El resto de los cartílagos
femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites conservados.
Edema de las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
No hay alteración de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Discreto edema óseo periférico del cóndilo femoral medial con imagen sugerente de pequeña
fractura subcortical.
Condropatía focal grado 2 - 3 de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal.
Fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial.

In the medial compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis along weight-baring, non weight-baring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes 
 The lateral compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is diffuse low grade chondrosis along weight-baring lateral femoral condyle. Focal high grade chondrosis with subchondral edema at lateral tibial plateau (about 1.8* 2 cm). Osteophytes are present.  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along medial, lateral patellar facets, medial and lateral trochleas. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 There is chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is anterior tibial translation. 
 There is chronic partial tear of the posteromedial oblique ligament. Chronic partial tears of the medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are suspected. The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Large amount of effusion with synovitis is present in right knee including popliteus recess. There are multiple osteocartilaginous loose bodies (about 1-2.5 cm) in right knee including suprapatellar bursa and popliteal recess. The surrounding musculature is normal.   -- Moderate tri-compartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema, cysts and osteophytes. 
 -- Radial tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. 
 -- Radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.  
 -- Chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.  
 -- Chronic partial tear of the posteromedial oblique ligament.  
 -- Chronic partial tears of the medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes. 
 -- Large amount of effusion with synovitis and multiple loose bodies (about 1-2.5 cm) in right knee including suprapatellar bursa and popliteal recess: probable for secondary synovial osteochondromatosis.

Lateralisiert stehende Patella. Ansonsten regelrechte Artikulationsverhältnisse. Tiefgreifender, bis an den knochenreichender Knorpeldefekt an der lateralen Patellafacette großflächig mit bis zu 1,7 cm und chondralen Fibrillationen (4/8). Angrenzend teils geringes Knochenmarködem (5/8). Femorotibial regelrechte Stellung. V. a. horizontale Rissbildung des Innenmeniskus in der Pars intermedia am Übergang zum Hinterhorn (5/26, 8/9 oder 3/125). Keine dislozierten Anteile. Kein Korbhenkelriss. Keine relevante Chondropathie femorotibial. Geringes subkortikales Ödem im medialen Tibiaplateau. Kreuzbänder intakt. Außenmeniskus intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Geringe Flüssigkeit um das MCL, DD bei Reizzustand. Signalanhebungen am Ansatz der Quadrizepssehne und am Ursprung der Patellasehne (8/28), in erster Linie bei Reizzustand. Flüssigkeitseinlagerungen in die umgebende Subcutis. Deutlicher Gelenkerguss mit im medialen und lateralen Recessus gelegenen kleinen länglichen Strukturen (3/25). Umgebende Muskulatur und Subkutis unauffällig.

FINDINGS:

There is a large knee joint effusion with synovitis. There is a nonruptured popliteal cyst.

There are severe degenerative changes in the medial and patellofemoral compartments with full-thickness cartilage loss and subchondral reactive changes. There is lateral subluxation and lateral tilt of the patella. There is moderate cartilage thinning involving the lateral compartment with a large cartilage defect of the central aspect of the lateral tibial plateau.

There is diffuse intrasubstance degeneration, maceration and degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus with meniscal extrusion. The lateral meniscus demonstrates intrasubstance degeneration of the body without a well-defined linear tear.

There is intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL. There is no evidence of acute ligament injury.

Otherwise the PCL, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Severe degenerative changes in the medial and patellofemoral compartments with full-thickness cartilage loss.

2. Diffuse degenerative tearing with maceration and extrusion of the medial meniscus.

3. Intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL without evidence of acute ligament injury.

4. Knee joint effusion with synovitis with a nonruptured popliteal cyst.

In the medial compartment, there is bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus, at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.  
 The medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.   -- Bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus, left knee. 
 -- Radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.  
 -- Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia derecha
Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial que no
impresiona contactar con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Rotura compleja del cuerno anterior, cuerpo y parte del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral con
segmento desplazado hacia el receso menisco tibial y edema las partes blandas regionales.
Edema óseo periférico del platillo tibial lateral con pequeña fractura subcortical regional y discreto
edema las partes blandas adyacentes.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la zona de carga de los compartimentos femorotibiales de
predominio lateral.
Úlceras condrales espesor parcial y total de distribución difusa de la articulación patelofemoral con
cambios óseos secundarios y proliferaciones óseas periféricas.
Moderado derrame articular con discreta sinovitis. Quiste poplíteo polilobulado, sin signos de
complicación categórica.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales, sin criterios de rotura. Tendón rotuliano, tendones
de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Rotura degenerativa del cuerno anterior, cuerpo y parte del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral
con segmento desplazado receso menisco tibial. Edema óseo periférico con pequeña fractura
subcortical del platillo tibial lateral, probablemente secundario a sobrecarga regional.
Condropatía lesiones grado dos y tres de los compartimentos femorotibiales de predominio lateral.
Condropatía lesiones grado 4 distribución difusa la articulación patelofemoral.
Moderado derrame articular con discreta sinovitis. Quiste poplíteo no complicado.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales

U proksimalnom prikazanom dijelu tibije prikazuje se T1 hipo-, PDFS hiperintenzivna lezija
lobuliranih kontura, promjera do 11 mm koja može odgovarati enhondromu. Ostale koštane
strukture su primjerenog intenziteta signala.
Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena.
Umjeren izljev u zglob, većinom suprapatelarno lateralno.
Edem prepatelarnih mekih tkiva.
Izrazito stanjena hrskavica medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba uz fisuru
kondilarne hrskavice u smislu hondromalacije III° te zonu denudacije tibijalne hrskavice te formirane rubne osteofite - OA promjene.
Hondromalacija I° kondilarne i tibijalne hrskavice lateralnog kompartmenta.
Hondromalacija III° patelarne i II° trohlearne hrskavice uz formirane rubne osteofite - OA promjene.
Prednji križni ligament je izmijenjenog intenziteta signala, smanjene napetosti posterolateralnog
snopa uz inkluzije tekućine - parcijalna ruptura.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta. Uz distalnu
polovinu stražnjeg križnog ligamenta prikazuju se cistične formacije promjera do 15 mm -
ganglion ciste.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova rupture ili degeneracije.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska s radijalnom komponentom.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog
kontinuiteta.
Distenzija, moguće manja parcijalna ruptura tetive m. popliteus.
Uredan prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa i patelarni ligament su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Ne nalazi se znakova poplitealne ciste.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı minimal artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Medyal menisküsün arka boynuzundaki yapı içi hafif dejenerasyon eklem yüzeylerine yırtık biçiminde ulaşmıyor. Lateral menisküsteki yaygın horizontal klivaj yırtığı serbest kenara ulaşıyor ve lateral parameniskal yaygın kistlerle çevreleniyor. Patellar apekste ve lateral fasette yer yer tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı dejenerasyonuna subkondral medüller hafif fibrovasküler değişiklikler eşlik ediyor. Diğer kesimlerde eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal).
